questions.stem: According to the passage, how many horticultural professionals does AAS enlist each year to serve as plant-trial judges?
questions.evidence: enlists more than 80 horticultural professionals from around the United States and Canada to serve as plant-trial judges
questions.explanation_ko: AAS는 매년 80명이 넘는 원예 전문가를 심사위원으로 모집한다고 나와 있습니다.

questions.stem: According to the passage, which of the following is NOT something the AAS judges compare when trialing new plants?
questions.evidence: The group then compares plant performance, time to reach full growth, flower or fruit size, disease resistance and other qualities important to home gardeners.
questions.explanation_ko: 심사위원들은 생육 속도, 꽃·열매 크기, 병 저항성 등을 비교하지만 소매가격은 언급되지 않았습니다.

questions.stem: What can be inferred about squash varieties that have a larger seed cavity than Green Lightning?
options: They would likely produce less edible flesh from each fruit.
They are not sold in North America.
They require more water to grow properly.
They were bred earlier than Green Lightning.
questions.evidence: Squash Green Lightning F1 was praised for its small seed cavity. This results in more edible flesh from each fruit.
questions.explanation_ko: 씨 공간이 작을수록 먹을 수 있는 과육이 많아진다고 했으므로, 씨 공간이 큰 품종은 과육이 상대적으로 적을 것이라 추론할 수 있습니다.

questions.stem: Why does the author mention that Murasaki translates to "purple" in Japanese?
options: To explain the origin of the cauliflower's name
To compare it to other Japanese vegetables
To describe how the plant is grown
questions.explanation_ko: 이 문장은 이 카울리플라워 품종명의 유래를 설명하기 위해 쓰였습니다.

questions.stem: In the passage, what does "bred" mean in "The fruit was created, or bred, by Bejo USA"?
questions.evidence: The fruit was created, or bred, by Bejo USA.
questions.explanation_ko: 여기서 bred는 선택적 재배를 통해 새 품종을 개발했다는 뜻입니다.

blanks.sentence_ko: Green Lightning은 시험에서 이름값을 했다고 심사위원들은 말했다.
그 심사위원은 조리했을 때 이 호박의 맛이 추가된 양념에도 밀리지 않았다고 말했다.
그 식물은 일찍 다 자라며 수확하기 쉽다고 전문가들은 말했다.

blanks.expression: easy to remove at harvest time
blanks.sentence_ko: Tonatico는 수확할 때 쉽게 떼어낼 수 있는, 고르게 붙은 열매송이로도 주목받았다.

key_points: Each year, the nonprofit All-America Selections group has over 80 judges compare new plant varieties against existing ones on traits like growth speed, size, and disease resistance.
For 2025, AAS named 20 winning plants, seven of which are edible.
The winning edible plants include a disease-resistant basil, a cherry tomato with reduced cracking, and two new purple vegetables, a cauliflower and a kohlrabi.
Other winners include a pepper resistant to bacterial leaf spot and two new squash varieties praised for their flesh yield and color-changing skin.
main_idea: Each year a panel of horticultural judges tests new plant varieties and names winners, and for 2025 several new fruits and vegetables were recognized for qualities like disease resistance, flavor, and yield.
restate_sentence: Judges praised the taste, texture, yield, disease resistance and reduced fruit cracking and splitting of this cherry tomato.
